# Simulation Study 1

```{r}
################################################
# Simulation Study 1
################################################
# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

# Simulation parameters
n <- 2000  # Number of observations
k <- 4    # Number of categories (must match the dimensions of sigma) 
p <- 4    # Number of predictors (including intercept)

# Simulate design matrix (X) with intercept
X <- cbind(1, matrix(rnorm(n * (p - 1)), n, p - 1))  # n x p matrix

# Simulate beta coefficients
beta <- matrix(c(1.9,-2.75,-2.9,3,-2.8,-9.5,2.5,-.15,.6,-.72,-3.2,5), nrow =p )  # p x k matrix

true_beta<-beta #columns represent category
true_beta_vector<-matrix(c(true_beta),ncol=1)

# Compute mean utilities (y_mean) for each observation and category
y_mean <- X %*% beta  # n x k matrix



# Use provided Sigma as the covariance matrix
sigma <- matrix(c(2, 0.5, -2, 
                  0.5, 2, 0.2, 
                  -2, 0.2, 4), nrow = 3)


true_sigma<-sigma


# Generate latent utilities (W)
latent_utilities <- (t(apply(y_mean, 1, function(mu) mvrnorm(1, mu, sigma)))) 

W <- cbind(rep(0,n),latent_utilities )


# Simulate observed responses
y <- apply(W, 1, which.max)

data<-data.frame(X,y)

```

## To generate Table 1 run the code below

Run the code below to reproduce Table 1 using the grid-based and shifted-beta proposal methods. For the shifted-beta method, change kappa to 50, 100, and 150 and run the corresponding code for each value.

```{r}

#######################################################
## To generate Table 1
#######################################################

nit=1000
nmc=400000
nthin=200
tau2=0.025^2
lamda2=100
proposal_step=.06

set.seed(12345)
MCMC_GridR_1st_simulation<-run_multinomial_univariate_mcmc(X, y,
                                                            nit=nit, nmc=nmc, nthin=nthin,
                                                            tau2=tau2,lamda2=lamda2,
                                                            proposal_step=proposal_step,
                                                            kappa = NULL,
                                                            S_update_method = "joint",
                                                            R_update_method = "grid")


save(MCMC_GridR_1st_simulation,file = file.path(path, "MCMC_GridR_1st_simulation.RData"))



Grid_summary <- compare_mnp_mcmc(
  fit = MCMC_GridR_1st_simulation,
  X = X,
  y = y,
  true_beta = true_beta,
  true_sigma = true_sigma
)

print(Grid_summary)




set.seed(12345)

kappa<-50 # change user input also to 100 and 150

MCMC_shifted_beta_1st_simulation<-run_multinomial_univariate_mcmc(X, y,
                                                                 nit=nit, nmc=nmc, nthin=nthin,
                                                                 tau2=tau2,lamda2=lamda2,
                                                                 proposal_step=proposal_step,
                                                                 kappa = kappa,
                                                                 S_update_method = "joint",
                                                                 R_update_method = "shifted_beta")


save(MCMC_shifted_beta_1st_simulation,file = file.path(path, "MCMC_shifted_beta_1st_simulation.RData"))


Grid_summary <- compare_mnp_mcmc(
  fit = MCMC_shifted_beta_1st_simulation,
  X = X,
  y = y,
  true_beta = true_beta,
  true_sigma = true_sigma
)

print(Grid_summary)

```

## To generate Figure 1 run the code below

Run the code below to reproduce Figure 1, which compares the posterior distributions of the regression coefficients and covariance parameters obtained using the joint $S$ and BN12 methods.

```{r}

###########################
## To generate Figure 1
###########################

# Posterior samples on the SAME scale
# Joint S uses product-of-variances = 1 identification.
Joint_S_beta  <- MCMC_GridR_1st_simulation$beta_final_vector
Joint_S_sigma <- MCMC_GridR_1st_simulation$sigma2_final

# BN12 trace-constrained draws must be RESCALED before comparison.
BN12_beta  <- MCMC_BN12_1st_simulation$BN12_Trace_beta_our_scale
BN12_sigma <- MCMC_BN12_1st_simulation$BN12_Trace_sigma_our_scale

q <- nrow(true_sigma)                     # number of non-baseline categories
p <- nrow(as.matrix(true_beta))          # predictors, including intercept
stopifnot(ncol(as.matrix(true_beta)) == q,
          nrow(Joint_S_beta) == p*q, nrow(BN12_beta) == p*q,
          all(dim(Joint_S_sigma)[1:2] == q),
          all(dim(BN12_sigma)[1:2] == q))

# Transform the true values to the identification scale of Joint S.
c_true <- prod(diag(true_sigma))^(1/q)
scaled_true_beta  <- c(true_beta) / sqrt(c_true)
scaled_true_sigma <- true_sigma / c_true  # do NOT round before plotting

model_colors <- c("Joint S" = "#1b9e77", "BN12" = "purple")

# Mark the true value red when it lies outside EITHER model's 95% HDI.
# The criterion is checked separately for each posterior distribution.
true_line_color <- function(draws_joint, draws_BN12, truth) {
  hj <- HDInterval::hdi(draws_joint, credMass = 0.95)
  hb <- HDInterval::hdi(draws_BN12, credMass = 0.95)
  if (truth >= hj[1] && truth <= hj[2] &&
      truth >= hb[1] && truth <= hb[2]) "black" else "red"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE 1 PANEL 1: regression coefficients
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
param_labels <- c("Intercept", paste0("Covariate ", seq_len(p - 1)))
plot_list <- vector("list", p*q)

for (i in seq_len(p*q)) {
  cat_index <- (i - 1) %/% p + 1
  cov_index <- (i - 1) %% p + 1
  truth <- scaled_true_beta[i]
  line_color <- true_line_color(Joint_S_beta[i, ], BN12_beta[i, ], truth)
  
  df_param <- data.frame(
    Draw = c(Joint_S_beta[i, ], BN12_beta[i, ]),
    Model = rep(c("Joint S", "BN12"),
                times = c(ncol(Joint_S_beta), ncol(BN12_beta)))
  )
  
  plot_list[[i]] <- ggplot(df_param, aes(x = Draw, color = Model)) +
    geom_density(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = truth, color = line_color,
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = if (cov_index == 1) paste("Category", cat_index) else NULL,
         title = if (cat_index == 1) param_labels[cov_index] else NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 26) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 26, hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "none")
}

panel1 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = q, ncol = p)
ggsave(filename = file.path(path, "Figure_1_panel_1.png"),
       plot = panel1, width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 200, units = "in")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# FIGURE 1 PANEL 2: variances and covariances (lower triangle)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
gather_posterior <- function(arr, label) {
  d <- dim(arr)[1]
  entries <- vector("list", d * (d + 1)/2)
  a <- 0L
  for (row in seq_len(d)) {
    for (col in seq_len(row)) {
      a <- a + 1L
      entries[[a]] <- data.frame(
        Model = label, Row = row, Col = col,
        Value = as.numeric(arr[row, col, ])
      )
    }
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(entries)
}

df_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  gather_posterior(Joint_S_sigma, "Joint S"),
  gather_posterior(BN12_sigma, "BN12")
)

line_data <- expand.grid(Row = seq_len(q), Col = seq_len(q)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Col <= Row) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    TrueValue = scaled_true_sigma[Row, Col],
    LineColor = true_line_color(
      Joint_S_sigma[Row, Col, ],
      BN12_sigma[Row, Col, ],
      TrueValue
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Print parameters for which at least one method's 95% HDI misses the truth.
print(line_data |> dplyr::filter(LineColor == "red"))

category_labels <- paste("Category", seq_len(q))
df_all <- df_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Row = factor(Row, levels = seq_len(q), labels = category_labels),
    Col = factor(Col, levels = seq_len(q), labels = category_labels)
  )
line_data <- line_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Row = factor(Row, levels = seq_len(q), labels = category_labels),
    Col = factor(Col, levels = seq_len(q), labels = category_labels)
  )

panel2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = df_all, aes(x = Value, color = Model),
               linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(data = line_data,
             aes(xintercept = TrueValue, color = LineColor),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(Row ~ Col, scales = "free", independent = "all",
                     switch = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(model_colors, "black" = "black", "red" = "red"),
                     breaks = names(model_colors), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 26) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 26),
        axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

ggsave(filename = file.path(path, "Figure_1_panel_2.png"),
       plot = panel2, width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 200, units = "in")

```

Run the code below to compare the predictive performance of the joint $S$ and BN12 methods using 30 repeated random training-test splits, with 5% of the data reserved for testing in each repetition. The code computes posterior predictive probabilities for both methods and saves the results for subsequent performance evaluation.

```{r}

############################################################
# Prediction: Joint S vs BN12
# 30 repeated random splits (5% test data)
############################################################

nit=1000
nmc=400000
nthin=200
tau2=0.025^2
lamda2=100
proposal_step=.06


# Joint S
estimated_PP_list_Joint_S <- list()

# BN12
estimated_PP_list_BN12 <- list()

# True probabilities and test responses
true_PP_list <- list()
test_Y_list <- list()

max_cv <- 30

for (cv in 1:max_cv) {
  
  set.seed(12345 + cv)
  
  ##########################################################
  # Split data
  ##########################################################
  
  index <- sample(
    nrow(data),
    size = nrow(data) * 0.05,
    replace = FALSE
  )
  
  test_data <- as.matrix(data[index, ])
  train_data <- as.matrix(data[-index, ])
  
  X <- as.matrix(train_data[, -ncol(train_data)])
  y <- as.numeric(train_data[, ncol(train_data)])
  
  X_test <- as.matrix(test_data[, -ncol(test_data)])
  y_test <- as.numeric(test_data[, ncol(test_data)])
  
  test_x_tilda <- diag(k - 1) %x% X_test
  
  true_X_test_Beta <- matrix(
    test_x_tilda %*% c(true_beta),
    ncol = k - 1
  )
  
  n_test <- length(y_test)
  
  ##########################################################
  # Joint S MCMC
  ##########################################################
  
  MCMC_Joint_S <- run_multinomial_univariate_mcmc(
    X, y,
    nit = nit,
    nmc = nmc,
    nthin = nthin,
    tau2 = tau2,
    lamda2 = lamda2,
    proposal_step = proposal_step,
    kappa = NULL,
    S_update_method = "joint",
    R_update_method = "grid"
  )
  
  Joint_S_beta <- MCMC_Joint_S$beta_final_vector
  Joint_S_sigma <- MCMC_Joint_S$sigma2_final
  
  ##########################################################
  # BN12 MCMC
  ##########################################################
  
  MCMC_BN12 <- run_multinomial_univariate_mcmc_BN12(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    nit = nit,
    nmc = nmc,
    nthin = nthin
  )
  
  BN12_beta <- MCMC_BN12$BN12_Trace_beta
  BN12_sigma <- MCMC_BN12$BN12_Trace_sigma
  
  ##########################################################
  # True probabilities
  ##########################################################
  
  true_PP <- apply(
    matrix(1:k, ncol = 1),
    1,
    new_probability_mnp_1response,
    mu = true_X_test_Beta,
    sigma = true_sigma,
    r = 250,
    Halton_choice = FALSE
  )
  
  true_PP_list[[cv]] <- true_PP
  
  ##########################################################
  # Estimated probabilities: Joint S
  ##########################################################
  
  estimated_PP_Joint_S <- array(
    NA_real_,
    dim = c(n_test, k, ncol(Joint_S_beta))
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(Joint_S_beta))) {
    
    test_X_BETA_tilda <- colSums(
      t(test_x_tilda) * c(Joint_S_beta[, i])
    )
    
    test_X_BETA <- matrix(
      test_X_BETA_tilda,
      ncol = k - 1
    )
    
    estimated_PP_Joint_S[, , i] <- apply(
      matrix(1:k, ncol = 1),
      1,
      new_probability_mnp_1response,
      mu = test_X_BETA,
      sigma = Joint_S_sigma[, , i],
      r = 250,
      Halton_choice = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  estimated_PP_list_Joint_S[[cv]] <- estimated_PP_Joint_S
  
  ##########################################################
  # Estimated probabilities: BN12
  ##########################################################
  
  estimated_PP_BN12 <- array(
    NA_real_,
    dim = c(n_test, k, ncol(BN12_beta))
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(BN12_beta))) {
    
    test_X_BETA_tilda <- colSums(
      t(test_x_tilda) * c(BN12_beta[, i])
    )
    
    test_X_BETA <- matrix(
      test_X_BETA_tilda,
      ncol = k - 1
    )
    
    estimated_PP_BN12[, , i] <- apply(
      matrix(1:k, ncol = 1),
      1,
      new_probability_mnp_1response,
      mu = test_X_BETA,
      sigma = BN12_sigma[, , i],
      r = 250,
      Halton_choice = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  estimated_PP_list_BN12[[cv]] <- estimated_PP_BN12
  
  ##########################################################
  # 7. Save test responses
  ##########################################################
  
  test_Y_list[[cv]] <- y_test
  
  cat("Completed CV:", cv, "of", max_cv, "\n")
  
}

#Save results
save(
  estimated_PP_list_Joint_S,
  estimated_PP_list_BN12,
  true_PP_list,
  test_Y_list,
  file = file.path(path, "Prediction_Joint_S_BN12.RData")
)

```

## Calculate Multiclass AUC and Reproduce Figure 2: ROC Curve Comparison

Run the code below to calculate the multiclass AUC and generate Figure 2, comparing the predictive performance of the joint $S$ and BN12 methods. The ROC curves and corresponding AUC values are computed for each response category using a one-vs-rest approach.

```{r}

##########################################################
# Calculate multiclass ROC AUC for Joint S and BN12
##########################################################

# True test classes (same for both methods)
True_class <- unlist(test_Y_list)


##########################################################
# Joint S
##########################################################

Full_estimated_PP_Joint_S <- abind(
  estimated_PP_list_Joint_S,
  along = 1
)

dimnames(Full_estimated_PP_Joint_S)[[2]] <- as.character(1:k)

auc_vec_joint_S <- sapply(
  1:dim(Full_estimated_PP_Joint_S)[3],
  function(i) {
    roc_obj <- multiclass.roc(
      True_class,
      Full_estimated_PP_Joint_S[, , i]
    )
    as.numeric(roc_obj$auc)
  }
)

cat("Joint S Mean AUC:", mean(auc_vec_joint_S), "\n")


##########################################################
# BN12
##########################################################

Full_estimated_PP_BN12 <- abind(
  estimated_PP_list_BN12,
  along = 1
)

dimnames(Full_estimated_PP_BN12)[[2]] <- as.character(1:k)

auc_vec_BN12 <- sapply(
  1:dim(Full_estimated_PP_BN12)[3],
  function(i) {
    roc_obj <- multiclass.roc(
      True_class,
      Full_estimated_PP_BN12[, , i]
    )
    as.numeric(roc_obj$auc)
  }
)

cat("BN12 Mean AUC:", mean(auc_vec_BN12), "\n")








############################################################
# To Generate Figure 2
############################################################

# load(file.path(path, "Prediction_Joint_S_BN12.RData"))

# Prediction results from the 30 CV repetitions
estimated_PP_joint <- estimated_PP_list_Joint_S
estimated_PP_BN12  <- estimated_PP_list_BN12

############################################################
# Combine all CV test predictions
############################################################

# Joint S
PP_joint <- abind(estimated_PP_joint, along = 1)

# BN12
PP_BN12 <- abind(estimated_PP_BN12, along = 1)

# Posterior mean probabilities across MCMC samples
PP_joint_mean <- apply(PP_joint, c(1, 2), mean)
PP_BN12_mean  <- apply(PP_BN12, c(1, 2), mean)

############################################################
# True classes
############################################################

True_class <- unlist(test_Y_list)

# Actual internal class labels
class_labels <- sort(unique(True_class))

k <- length(class_labels)

# Internal 1,2,3,4 -> Category 0,1,2,3
display_labels <- 0:(k - 1)

# Check dimensions
stopifnot(
  nrow(PP_joint_mean) == length(True_class),
  nrow(PP_BN12_mean) == length(True_class),
  ncol(PP_joint_mean) == k,
  ncol(PP_BN12_mean) == k
)

############################################################
# Calculate one-vs-rest ROC and AUC
############################################################

roc_joint <- vector("list", k)
roc_BN12  <- vector("list", k)

auc_joint <- numeric(k)
auc_BN12  <- numeric(k)

for (j in 1:k) {
  
  y_binary <- as.numeric(True_class == class_labels[j])
  
  # Joint S
  roc_joint[[j]] <- roc(
    y_binary,
    PP_joint_mean[, j],
    quiet = TRUE,
    direction = "<"
  )
  
  # BN12
  roc_BN12[[j]] <- roc(
    y_binary,
    PP_BN12_mean[, j],
    quiet = TRUE,
    direction = "<"
  )
  
  auc_joint[j] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_joint[[j]]))
  auc_BN12[j]  <- as.numeric(auc(roc_BN12[[j]]))
}

############################################################
# Save ROC plot
############################################################

png(
  filename = file.path(path, "Figure_2.png"),
  height = 2000,
  width = 2000,
  res = 300
)

par(
  mfrow = c(2, 2),
  mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2.5, 1)
)

for (j in 1:k) {
  
  # Joint S ROC coordinates
  joint_fpr <- 1 - roc_joint[[j]]$specificities
  joint_tpr <- roc_joint[[j]]$sensitivities
  
  # BN12 ROC coordinates
  BN12_fpr <- 1 - roc_BN12[[j]]$specificities
  BN12_tpr <- roc_BN12[[j]]$sensitivities
  
  # Joint S
  plot(
    joint_fpr,
    joint_tpr,
    type = "l",
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i",
    col = "#1b9e77",
    lwd = 2.4,
    lty = 1,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    main = paste0("Category ", display_labels[j]),
    cex.axis = 1.5,
    cex.lab = 1.3,
    cex.main = 1.3
  )
  
  # BN12
  lines(
    BN12_fpr,
    BN12_tpr,
    col = "purple",
    lwd = 2.3,
    lty = 2
  )
  
  # Random classifier reference line
  abline(
    a = 0,
    b = 1,
    lty = 3,
    col = "gray60"
  )
  
  # AUC values inside plot
  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c(
      paste0(
        "Joint S (AUC = ",
        sprintf("%.4f", auc_joint[j]),
        ")"
      ),
      paste0(
        "BN12 (AUC = ",
        sprintf("%.4f", auc_BN12[j]),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    col = c("#1b9e77", "purple"),
    lwd = 2,
    lty = c(1, 2),
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.9
  )
}

dev.off()


```

## Calculate Probability Distance Measures and Reproduce Figure 3

Run the code below to generate Figure 3, which compares the predictive accuracy of the joint $S$ and BN12 methods using three probability distance measures: total variation distance (TVD), Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence, and Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD). These measures are calculated by comparing the estimated posterior predictive probabilities with the corresponding true probabilities across the repeated test samples.

```{r}

##########################
# To Generate Figure 3
#########################

# # Load prediction results for Joint S and BN12
# load(file.path(path, "Prediction_Joint_S_BN12.RData"))

# ==========================================================
# Method 1: Joint S
# ==========================================================

estimated_PP_list <- estimated_PP_list_Joint_S

cat("\nCalculating distances for Joint S...\n")

dist_joint <- calculate_distances(
  estimated_PP_list,
  true_PP_list
)

points     <- dist_joint$TVD
points_KL  <- dist_joint$KL
points_JSD <- dist_joint$JSD


# ==========================================================
# Method 2: BN12
# ==========================================================

estimated_PP_list <- estimated_PP_list_BN12

cat("\nCalculating distances for BN12...\n")

dist_BN12 <- calculate_distances(
  estimated_PP_list,
  true_PP_list
)

points1     <- dist_BN12$TVD
points1_KL  <- dist_BN12$KL
points1_JSD <- dist_BN12$JSD


# ==========================================================
# Plot: TVD, KL Divergence, and JSD
# ==========================================================

png(
  filename = file.path(path, "Figure_3.png"),
  width = 1800,
  height = 650,
  res = 150
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1),
  oma = c(4, 0, 0, 0)
)



plot_comparison <- function(x1, x2, main_title) {
  
  yr <- range(c(x1, x2), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Add vertical padding
  padding <- diff(yr) * 0.05
  
  if (padding == 0) {
    padding <- max(abs(yr[1]) * 0.05, 0.001)
  }
  
  yr <- c(
    yr[1] - padding,
    yr[2] + padding
  )
  
  plot(
    seq_along(x1),
    x1,
    type = "b",
    ylim = yr,
    col = "#1b9e77",
    lwd = 2.4,
    pch = 17,
    cex = 1,
    cex.axis = 1.2,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    main = main_title,
    cex.main = 1.2
  )
  
  points(
    seq_along(x2),
    x2,
    type = "b",
    col = "purple",
    lwd = 2.3,
    pch = 16,
    cex = 1
  )
}


# Panel 1: Total Variation Distance
plot_comparison( points, points1, "")

# Panel 2: KL Divergence
plot_comparison(points_KL,points1_KL,"")

# Panel 3: Jensen-Shannon Divergence
plot_comparison(points_JSD,points1_JSD,"")


par(
  fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
  oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  new = TRUE
)

plot.new()

legend(
  "bottom",
  legend = c("Joint S", "BN12"),
  col = c("#1b9e77", "purple"),
  lwd = 2.2,
  pch = c(17, 16),
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.2,
  inset = c(0, 0.01)
)

dev.off()


# Summary Table: Mean distances
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Joint S", "BN12"),
  
  TVD = c(mean(points),mean(points1)),
  
  KL = c( mean(points_KL), mean(points1_KL)),
  
  JSD = c( mean(points_JSD), mean(points1_JSD))
)

print(summary_table, digits = 4)

```

# Simulation Study 2

```{r}

########################
# Simulation Study 2
########################



# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

# Simulation parameters
n <- 2000  # Number of observations
k <- 7    # Number of categories (must match the dimensions of sigma) 
p <- 2    # Number of predictors (including intercept)

m<-2  # the size of gamma

# Simulate design matrix (X) with intercept
X <- cbind(1, matrix(rnorm(n * (p - 1)), n, p - 1))  # n x p matrix

beta <- matrix(c(-2, -0.40, -0.45 , 0.40, -0.76 , 1.20 ,-0.44, -0.60 ,-0.53  ,0.20 ,-3.32 , 1.00),nrow=p)

true_beta<-beta
true_beta_vector<-matrix(c(true_beta),ncol=1)

# Compute mean utilities (y_mean) for each observation and category
y_mean <- X %*% beta  # n x k matrix




R<-diag(k-1)

set.seed(12345)
Z <- matrix(rnorm((k-1)*2,0,1),ncol=m)


gamma<- 2* matrix(c(.2, .5), ncol = 1)

log_S<-Z %*%gamma

log_S=log_S-mean(log_S)


# Use provided Sigma as the covariance matrix
sigma <- t( c(exp(log_S)) * R) * c(exp(log_S))

true_sigma<-sigma


# Generate latent utilities (W)
latent_utilities <- (t(apply(y_mean, 1, function(mu) mvrnorm(1, mu, sigma)))) 

W <- cbind(rep(0,n),latent_utilities )


# Simulate observed responses
y <- apply(W, 1, which.max)

print(table(y))

x2<-X


data<-data.frame(x2,y)

```

```{r}
# --- Function to gather posterior samples ---
gather_posterior <- function(sigma_array, model_name) {
  n <- dim(sigma_array)[1]
  df_list <- list()
  
  for (row in 1:n) {
    for (col in 1:n) {
      vals <- sigma_array[row, col, ]
      param_type <- if (row == col) "Variance" else "Covariance"
      param_name <- if (row == col) paste0("Var", row) else paste0("Cov", row, col)
      
      df_list[[length(df_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        Row = row,
        Col = col,
        ParamType = param_type,
        ParamName = param_name,
        Value = vals
      )
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(df_list)
}

# --- Gather posterior draws ---
df_separate <- gather_posterior(Conditional_S_sigma, "Conditional S")
df_simul    <- gather_posterior(Joint_S_sigma, "Joint S")

row_labels <- c(paste0("Category ", 1:3), paste0("Category  ", 1:4))
col_labels <- c(paste0("Category ", 1:3), paste0("Category  ", 1:4))

# --- Combine and prepare ---
df_all <- bind_rows(df_separate, df_simul) %>%
  filter(Col <= Row) %>%  # keep lower triangle + diagonal
  mutate(
    Row = factor(Row, levels = 1:7, labels =row_labels),
    Col = factor(Col, levels = 1:7, labels = col_labels)
  )



# --- True value dataframe ---
true_vals_df <- expand.grid(Row = 1:7, Col = 1:7) %>%
  filter(Col <= Row) %>%
  mutate(
    TrueValue = scaled_true_sigma[cbind(Row, Col)],
    Row = factor(Row, levels = 1:7, labels = row_labels),
    Col = factor(Col, levels = 1:7, labels = col_labels)
  )

# --- Compute 95% HDIs per Model/Row/Col ---
hdi_df <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Model, Row, Col) %>%
  summarise(
    hdi_low = hdi(Value, credMass = 0.95)[1],
    hdi_high = hdi(Value, credMass = 0.95)[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --- Merge true values with HDIs ---
true_vals_with_color <- expand.grid(
  Model = c("Conditional S", "Joint S"),
  Row = levels(df_all$Row),
  Col = levels(df_all$Col)
) %>%
  left_join(true_vals_df, by = c("Row", "Col")) %>%
  left_join(hdi_df, by = c("Model", "Row", "Col")) %>%
  mutate(
    InHDI = ifelse(TrueValue >= hdi_low & TrueValue <= hdi_high, TRUE, FALSE),
    LineColor = ifelse(InHDI, "black", "red")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TrueValue), !is.na(LineColor))  # remove missing safely

# --- Optional: print which true values are outside 95% HDI ---
out_of_hdi <- true_vals_with_color %>%
  filter(LineColor == "red") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c("Model", "Row", "Col", "TrueValue", "hdi_low", "hdi_high")))

if (nrow(out_of_hdi) > 0) {
  message("True values outside 95% HDI:\n")
  print(out_of_hdi)
}


png(filename = file.path(path, "Figure_4_panel_3.png"),height = 700,width=1800)


# --- Plot ---
ggplot() +
  # Posterior densities
  geom_density(
    data = df_all,
    aes(x = Value, color = Model, linetype = Model),
    size = 1.2, fill = NA, key_glyph = "path"
  ) +
  # Vertical lines for true values, color-coded by HDI inclusion
  geom_vline(
    data = true_vals_with_color,
    aes(xintercept = TrueValue, color = LineColor),
    linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2, key_glyph = "path"
  ) +
  facet_grid2(
    Row ~ Col,
    scales = "free",
    independent = "all",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Conditional S" = "purple",
      "Joint S" = "#1b9e77",
      "black" = "black",
      "red" = "red"
    ),
    breaks = c("Conditional S", "Joint S"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Conditional S" = "solid",
      "Joint S" = "solid"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16,  face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


dev.off()


```




## Evaluate Predictive Performance and Reproduce Figure 5: ROC Curve Comparison for Simulation Study 3

Run the code below to compare the predictive performance of the conditional \(S\) and joint \(S\) methods using 30 repeated random training-test splits, with 5% of the data reserved for testing in each repetition. The code calculates the multiclass AUC and generates Figure 5, displaying one-vs-rest ROC curves and corresponding AUC values for each joint response category.

```{r}

nit=1000
nmc=400000
nthin=200
lamda2=100
proposal_step=.08

##For prediction Conditional S and Joint S
estimated_PP_Conditional_list<-list()
estimated_PP_Joint_list<-list()
true_PP_list<-list()
test_Y_list<-list()

max_cv<-30

for(cv in 1:max_cv){
  
  set.seed(12345+cv)
  
  index<-sample(nrow(data),size=nrow(data)*.05,replace=F)
  test_data<-as.matrix(data[index,])
  train_data<-as.matrix(data[-index,])
  
  data1<-train_data[,c(1:(p1+1))]
  data2<-train_data[,c((p1+2):ncol(data))]
  
  X1<-as.matrix(data1[,-(p1+1)])
  X2<-as.matrix(data2[,-(p2+1)])
  
  y1<-as.numeric(data1[,ncol(data1)])
  y2<-as.numeric(data2[,ncol(data2)])
  
  test_data1<-test_data[,c(1:(p1+1))]
  test_data2<-test_data[,c((p1+2):ncol(data))]
  
  x1_test<-as.matrix(test_data1[,-(p1+1)])
  x2_test<-as.matrix(test_data2[,-(p2+1)])
  
  y1_test<-as.numeric(test_data1[,ncol(test_data1)])
  y2_test<-as.numeric(test_data2[,ncol(test_data2)])
  
  n_test<-nrow(test_data)
  
  test_x1_tilda<-diag((k1-1)) %x% x1_test
  test_x2_tilda<-diag((k2-1)) %x% x2_test
  
  true_X1_Beta<-matrix(test_x1_tilda%*%c(true_beta[1:((k1-1)*p1)]),ncol=(k1-1))
  true_X2_Beta<-matrix(test_x2_tilda%*%c(true_beta[(((k1-1)*p1)+1):length(true_beta)]),ncol=(k2-1))
  
  true_PP<-apply(matrix(1:(k1*k2),ncol=1),1,new_probability_mnp_2response,k1,k2,mu1=true_X1_Beta,mu2=true_X2_Beta,sigma=true_sigma,r=250,Halton_choice=FALSE)
  true_PP_list[[cv]]<-true_PP
  
  test_Y_list[[cv]]<-cbind(y1_test,y2_test)
  
  
  ## Conditional S
  tau2=.04^2
  
  MCMC_Conditional_S<-run_multinomial_bivariate_Conditional_S_mcmc(X1,X2,y1,y2,
                                                                   nit=nit,nmc=nmc,nthin=nthin,
                                                                   tau2=tau2,lamda2=lamda2,
                                                                   proposal_step=proposal_step)
  
  Conditional_S_beta<-MCMC_Conditional_S$beta_final_vector
  Conditional_S_sigma<-MCMC_Conditional_S$sigma2_final
  Conditional_S_S<-MCMC_Conditional_S$S_final
  Conditional_S_R<-MCMC_Conditional_S$R_final
  
  estimated_PP_Conditional<-array(NA,dim=c(n_test,k1*k2,ncol(Conditional_S_beta)))
  
  for(i in 1:ncol(Conditional_S_beta)){
    
    test_X1_Beta<-matrix(test_x1_tilda%*%c(Conditional_S_beta[,i][1:((k1-1)*p1)]),ncol=(k1-1))
    test_X2_Beta<-matrix(test_x2_tilda%*%c(Conditional_S_beta[,i][(((k1-1)*p1)+1):nrow(Conditional_S_beta)]),ncol=(k2-1))
    
    estimated_PP_Conditional[,,i]<-apply(matrix(1:(k1*k2),ncol=1),1,new_probability_mnp_2response,k1,k2,mu1=test_X1_Beta,mu2=test_X2_Beta,sigma=Conditional_S_sigma[,,i],r=250,Halton_choice=FALSE)
  }
  
  estimated_PP_Conditional_list[[cv]]<-estimated_PP_Conditional
  
  
  ## Joint S
  tau2=.015^2
  
  MCMC_Joint_S<-run_multinomial_bivariate_Joint_S_mcmc(X1,X2,y1,y2,
                                                       nit=nit,nmc=nmc,nthin=nthin,
                                                       tau2=tau2,lamda2=lamda2,
                                                       proposal_step=proposal_step)
  
  Joint_S_beta<-MCMC_Joint_S$beta_final_vector
  Joint_S_sigma<-MCMC_Joint_S$sigma2_final
  Joint_S_S<-MCMC_Joint_S$S_final
  Joint_S_R<-MCMC_Joint_S$R_final
  
  estimated_PP_Joint<-array(NA,dim=c(n_test,k1*k2,ncol(Joint_S_beta)))
  
  for(i in 1:ncol(Joint_S_beta)){
    
    test_X1_Beta<-matrix(test_x1_tilda%*%c(Joint_S_beta[,i][1:((k1-1)*p1)]),ncol=(k1-1))
    test_X2_Beta<-matrix(test_x2_tilda%*%c(Joint_S_beta[,i][(((k1-1)*p1)+1):nrow(Joint_S_beta)]),ncol=(k2-1))
    
    estimated_PP_Joint[,,i]<-apply(matrix(1:(k1*k2),ncol=1),1,new_probability_mnp_2response,k1,k2,mu1=test_X1_Beta,mu2=test_X2_Beta,sigma=Joint_S_sigma[,,i],r=250,Halton_choice=FALSE)
  }
  
  estimated_PP_Joint_list[[cv]]<-estimated_PP_Joint
  
  cat("Completed CV:",cv,"\n")
}






##########################
##Calculate the ROC for Conditional S and Joint S

True_class<-abind(test_Y_list,along=1)

f<-function(a){
  (a[1]-1)*k2+a[2]
}

True_class1<-apply(True_class,1,f)


## Conditional S
Full_estimated_PP_Conditional<-abind(estimated_PP_Conditional_list,along=1)
dimnames(Full_estimated_PP_Conditional)[[2]]<-as.character(1:(k1*k2))

auc_vec_Conditional_S<-sapply(1:dim(Full_estimated_PP_Conditional)[3],function(k){
  roc_obj<-multiclass.roc(True_class1,Full_estimated_PP_Conditional[,,k])
  as.numeric(roc_obj$auc)
})

print(mean(auc_vec_Conditional_S))


## Joint S
Full_estimated_PP_Joint<-abind(estimated_PP_Joint_list,along=1)
dimnames(Full_estimated_PP_Joint)[[2]]<-as.character(1:(k1*k2))

auc_vec_Joint_S<-sapply(1:dim(Full_estimated_PP_Joint)[3],function(k){
  roc_obj<-multiclass.roc(True_class1,Full_estimated_PP_Joint[,,k])
  as.numeric(roc_obj$auc)
})

print(mean(auc_vec_Joint_S))


## Comparison
AUC_results<-data.frame(
  Method=c("Conditional S","Joint S"),
  Mean_AUC=c(mean(auc_vec_Conditional_S),mean(auc_vec_Joint_S))
)

print(AUC_results)








################################
# To generate Figure 5
###############################

estimated_PP_joint <- estimated_PP_Joint_list
estimated_PP_conditional <- estimated_PP_Conditional_list


# Create true joint class
True_class_pair <- abind(test_Y_list, along = 1)

f <- function(a) {
  (a[1] - 1) * k2 + a[2]
}

True_class <- apply(True_class_pair, 1, f)

n_class <- k1 * k2


# Combine posterior predicted probabilities across CV
PP_joint <- abind(estimated_PP_joint, along = 1)
PP_conditional <- abind(estimated_PP_conditional, along = 1)

# Posterior mean predicted probabilities
PP_joint_mean <- apply(PP_joint, c(1, 2), mean)
PP_conditional_mean <- apply(PP_conditional, c(1, 2), mean)

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(nrow(PP_joint_mean) == length(True_class))
stopifnot(nrow(PP_conditional_mean) == length(True_class))
stopifnot(ncol(PP_joint_mean) == n_class)
stopifnot(ncol(PP_conditional_mean) == n_class)


# One-vs-rest ROC objects and AUC
roc_joint <- vector("list", n_class)
roc_conditional <- vector("list", n_class)

auc_joint <- numeric(n_class)
auc_conditional <- numeric(n_class)

for (j in 1:n_class) {
  
  y_binary <- as.numeric(True_class == j)
  
  roc_joint[[j]] <- roc(
    y_binary,
    PP_joint_mean[, j],
    quiet = TRUE,
    direction = "<"
  )
  
  roc_conditional[[j]] <- roc(
    y_binary,
    PP_conditional_mean[, j],
    quiet = TRUE,
    direction = "<"
  )
  
  auc_joint[j] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_joint[[j]]))
  auc_conditional[j] <- as.numeric(auc(roc_conditional[[j]]))
}


joint_labels <- expand.grid(
  Y2 = 0:(k2 - 1),
  Y1 = 0:(k1 - 1)
)

panel_titles <- paste0(
  "Category (",
  joint_labels$Y1, ",",
  joint_labels$Y2, ")"
)


png(
  filename = file.path(path, "Figure_5.png"),
  width = 14,
  height = 11,
  units = "in",
  res = 600
)

par(
  mfrow = c(k1, k2),
  mar = c(2.3, 2.3, 2.2, 0.8),
  oma = c(4, 4, 2, 1)
)

for (j in 1:n_class) {
  
  joint_fpr <- 1 - roc_joint[[j]]$specificities
  joint_tpr <- roc_joint[[j]]$sensitivities
  
  conditional_fpr <- 1 - roc_conditional[[j]]$specificities
  conditional_tpr <- roc_conditional[[j]]$sensitivities
  
  plot(
    joint_fpr,
    joint_tpr,
    type = "l",
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i",
    col = "#1b9e77",
    lwd = 2,
    lty = 1,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    main = panel_titles[j],
    cex.axis = 0.85,
    cex.main = 0.9
  )
  
  lines(
    conditional_fpr,
    conditional_tpr,
    col = "purple",
    lwd = 2,
    lty = 2
  )
  
  abline(
    a = 0,
    b = 1,
    lty = 3,
    col = "gray60"
  )
  
  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c(
      paste0("Joint S (AUC = ", sprintf("%.4f", auc_joint[j]), ")"),
      paste0("Conditional S (AUC = ", sprintf("%.4f", auc_conditional[j]), ")")
    ),
    col = c("#1b9e77", "purple"),
    lwd = 2,
    lty = c(1, 2),
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.9,
    seg.len = 2
  )
}

dev.off()

```


## Calculate Probability Distance Measures and Reproduce Figure 6

Run the code below to generate Figure 6, which compares the predictive accuracy of the joint \(S\) and conditional \(S\) methods using total variation distance (TVD), Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence, and Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD). These measures are computed by comparing the estimated posterior predictive probabilities with the corresponding true probabilities across the repeated test samples.


```{r}

#################################
# To Generate Figure 6
#################################

# Method 1: Joint S
estimated_PP_list <- estimated_PP_Joint_list

cat("\nCalculating distances for Joint S...\n")

dist_joint <- calculate_distances(
  estimated_PP_list,
  true_PP_list
)

points     <- dist_joint$TVD
points_KL  <- dist_joint$KL
points_JSD <- dist_joint$JSD


# Method 2: Conditional S

estimated_PP_list <- estimated_PP_Conditional_list

cat("\nCalculating distances for Conditional S...\n")

dist_Conditional <- calculate_distances(
  estimated_PP_list,
  true_PP_list
)

points1     <- dist_Conditional$TVD
points1_KL  <- dist_Conditional$KL
points1_JSD <- dist_Conditional$JSD


# ==========================================================
# Plot: TVD, KL Divergence, and JSD
# ==========================================================

png(
  filename = file.path(path, "Figure_6.png"),
  width = 1800,
  height = 650,
  res = 150
)

par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1),
  oma = c(4, 0, 0, 0)
)


plot_comparison <- function(x1, x2, main_title) {
  
  yr <- range(c(x1, x2), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Add vertical padding
  padding <- diff(yr) * 0.05
  
  if (padding == 0) {
    padding <- max(abs(yr[1]) * 0.05, 0.001)
  }
  
  yr <- c(
    yr[1] - padding,
    yr[2] + padding
  )
  
  plot(
    seq_along(x1),
    x1,
    type = "b",
    ylim = yr,
    col = "#1b9e77",
    lwd = 2.4,
    pch = 17,
    cex = 1,
    cex.axis = 1.2,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    main = main_title,
    cex.main = 1.2
  )
  
  points(
    seq_along(x2),
    x2,
    type = "b",
    col = "purple",
    lwd = 2.3,
    pch = 16,
    cex = 1
  )
}


# Panel 1: Total Variation Distance
plot_comparison(points,points1,"")

# Panel 2: KL Divergence
plot_comparison(points_KL,points1_KL,"")

# Panel 3: Jensen-Shannon Divergence
plot_comparison(points_JSD,points1_JSD,"")


par(
  fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
  oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  new = TRUE
)

plot.new()

legend(
  "bottom",
  legend = c("Joint S", "Conditional S"),
  col = c("#1b9e77", "purple"),
  lwd = 2.2,
  pch = c(17, 16),
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.2,
  inset = c(0, 0.01)
)

dev.off()


# Summary Table: Mean distances
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Joint S", "Conditional S"),
  
  TVD = c(mean(points),mean(points1)),
  
  KL = c(mean(points_KL),mean(points1_KL)),
  
  JSD = c(mean(points_JSD),mean(points1_JSD))
)

print(summary_table, digits = 4)


```
